semantic_meaning: Summarizes the system into a final leverage map: structure (cyan), leverage points (amber), consequences (red only if explicit).
when_to_use: Episode wrap-up to restate where leverage exists
After presenting evidence and mechanism to unify the story
As a final actionable system map
when_not_to_use: If the episode did not establish leverage points with evidence
To introduce new claims without sources

animation_behavior.description: Map builds (cyan), leverage points appear (amber), optional red consequence layer toggles for explicit risk; ends with locked, readable map.

input_parameters.name: leverage_node_ids
input_parameters.description: Nodes that are leverage points (amber markers/rings).

input_parameters.name: consequence_node_ids
input_parameters.description: Nodes tied to explicit consequences (red layer only if used).

state_beats.label: risk_toggle
state_beats.meaningful_change: Optional red consequence overlay toggles on/off.

state_beats.label: final_lock
state_beats.meaningful_change: Final map locks; camera holds briefly then ends.

expected_outputs: A final summary map with clear leverage markings and optional consequence layer
validation_notes: If red is present, it must correspond to explicit consequence/failure/exposure claims.
Leverage points must have been established earlier in the episode.
